impact: Cloud infrastructure destroyed on 2 Nov; second DDoS on 15 Nov slowed recovery
date_note: Second attack reported 15 Nov; the first attack was on 2 Nov. Time of day not stated.
title: Russian host Beget hit by second large DDoS while rebuilding cloud destroyed on 2 November
summary: Hosting provider Beget said on 15 November it faced a second large DDoS attack in two weeks, which it said was aimed at disrupting its recovery. The Moscow Times gives 2.1 Tbit/s and iStories up to 850 Gbit/s. On 2 November the company said its cloud infrastructure had been destroyed; iStories lists lost VPS data, S3 storage and Kubernetes clusters. Beget blames unnamed hackers.
plain: A big Russian web host was hit by a second flood attack while still rebuilding from an earlier one that wiped its cloud service.
exec: Shows how one provider's outage and data loss can take down many customers' sites and email at once.
action: Beget customers: check your own off-host backups and follow the provider's status channel. Others: confirm you can restore hosted sites and DNS elsewhere.

validation.note: Two independent outlets agree on dates and Beget's statement; attack size differs between them; Beget's own Telegram was not read. Headquarters city not stated in sources, so pinned at country level.
